title: introduce-prefill-sentinel-compactizer-and-cli-for-tenant-econ
author: Lina Park
description: Motivation: tenant warmstart and prefill heuristics currently produce suboptimal cache utilization for low-cardinality workloads which inflates per-token cost. This PR adds a lightweight runtime 'prefill sentinel' that compacts low-value KV entries and a companion CLI to synthesize tenant prefill profiles and surface conservative quantization suggestions. The goal is to reduce tail token spend and improve contiguous cache hit rates without changing public API behavior. Implementation summary: added a sentinel compactizer algorithm in the runtime prefill path to detect stale/low-reuse KV prefixes, a tenant-level sampler and scoring function to derive compacting thresholds, a compact-while-warmup mode for Dedicated instances, metrics/tracing hooks for hit-rate impact, and a small CLI tool (prefillctl) that generates recommended batch/cache/quant presets from historical traces. This single-string description contains the full PR context, design tradeoffs, testing notes, and rollout plan: design decisions (heuristic thresholding, safety fallthroughs, per-tenant opt-out), testing (unit tests for compactizer, integration smoke in benchmark-lab with 100k synthetic requests, manual QA on staging Dedicated), rollback plan (feature flag disable and config revert), rollout (canary on 3 tenants -> 15% -> 50% -> global), and backward-compatibility assurances.

Lina Park (author): Will flip to opt-in by default and add a config knob. Also added conservative limits in the scoring function so we only compact when reuse < 5% over a 5min window.
Mateo Alvarez: Please add a short note explaining interactions with KV cache persistence and HSM-backed KMS; we should not compact entries when persistence is required for auditability.
Lina Park (author): Added a check to skip compacting on tenants with persistence=true in config and documented behavior in prefills.md.

release_notes: Add Prefill Sentinel compactizer to improve cache hit-rate for low-cardinality workloads; introduce prefillctl CLI for generating conservative batch/cache/quant presets. Rollout gated by config flag; safe rollback by disabling the feature flag.
